IDQ20885
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology
Queensland

Major Flood Warning for the Logan and Albert Rivers
Issued at 4:52 am EST on Monday 28 February 2022
Flood Warning Number: 12

MAJOR FLOODING IS OCCURRING ALONG THE LOGAN RIVER

Heavy rainfall over the past 72 hours has caused major river level rises.

Logan River:
Major flooding is occurring along the Logan River. The Logan River at
Waterford is currently at 12.50 metres and rising, with major flooding. The
Logan River at Waterford is likely to peak around 13.50 metres Monday
afternoon, with major flooding.

Albert River:
The Albert River at Bromfleet peaked at 15.80 metres Sunday evening and is
now falling, with moderate flooding. The Albert River at Wolffdene is
expected to remain above 10.00 metres during Monday, with major flooding.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 11:00 am EST Monday 28 February.

Latest River Heights:
Logan R at Waterford *     12.50  Rising   Major     04:00 AM MON 28/02/22
Albert R at Bromfleet *    15.20  Falling  Moderate  04:00 AM MON 28/02/22
